name: Vision Luft
desc: An enhanced version of a Luft. The gale that encircles the whirling blade has all the force of a tornado, and a simple swing sends out sharp air blades that mercilessly mangle enemies.

eff.name: Spiral Blade
eff.desc1: Deals [10 + (Lv. x 20)] power air damage. Damage is increased if Battle Rate is over 100%.

eff.name: Exorcising Breeze
eff.desc1: Reduces ATK, DEF, and SPD by [Lv. x 3]% if the target is inflicted with Restraints.
eff.desc2: Grants a [Lv. x 10]% chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Restraints on the target.

eff.name: Tempestuous Gale
eff.desc2: Lowers target's air resistance by [Lv. x 1] stage(s).
